findings.rationale: Command registration erases TAuthorizer, so the server cannot AOT-dispatch the frozen authorization contract.
UnreliableSequenced queues every increasing packet instead of retaining only the latest, and malformed sequence-zero input can affect the watermark.
Decode allocates arrays and per-record byte buffers before complete framing and minimum-size validation, allowing malformed tiny payloads to force large GC allocation.
UUID writes call Guid.ToByteArray per identifier in packet and schema hot paths.
Typed values are decoded only into discard during validation; no staged typed representation survives before future ECS mutation.
Frozen golden, malformed, schema matrix, latest-only unreliable, and lease misuse acceptance coverage is incomplete.

validation: Exact base/head and merge-base verified; worktree clean; range owns only unigame.staticecs.network/**
72-byte header offsets, little-endian fields, CRC, enum limits, manifest ordering and default history caps statically verified
